_: Counter attendants (workstream Q, design/godot-dialogue.md 'Attendants'). One unique person behind each counter. wing/years: where they exist (a store closed that year has none). skin: an npc/skins.json id the wing's pack ships (Ch*/Remy); Steven may swap. area: [x0, z0, x1, z1] world metres behind the counter they wander in; face: the direction they stand facing (toward the shop floor); talk_at: where the interactable stands (the shop side of the counter, so the 1.6 m reach works across it). name and dialogue are PLACEHOLDERs until Steven writes them. redemption: true = the redemption screen (session R) opens first when it exists. INT (Demo 49): "spots" (workstream GI) are places only; story.gd reads "attendants" and ignores "spots". look (CHAR-STRIP, Nov 8 2026, design/godot-avatar.md): "cast" + "cast": "<id>" = that cast member from data/cast.json, made by scripts/cast.gd Cast.body; "mixamo" = the skin above, for attendants with no cast member yet (written here, never decided at runtime). Every attendant is "mixamo" until CHAR-BUILD delivers its cast files. shop (SHOPS, design/godot-shops.md): a shop id in data/story/shops.json; talking opens its list (scripts/shop.gd) instead of a dialogue.
